questions.q_en: 70% of students in a coaching institute are males out of which 80% are vegetarian. If 49 male students are non-vegetarian, then how many female students are there in the coaching institute?
questions.solution_en:
In coaching institute:

Let the total number of students = n

Then, number of male students = 70% of n = 0.7n

And the number of male students who are non-vegetarian = (100 - 80)% of 0.7n = 0.14n

Then, 49 = 0.14n

n = 350

Therefore, number of female students = n - 0.7n = 0.3n = 0.3 * 350 = 105

questions.q_en: Two trains with a speed of 80 km/h and 120 km/h, respectively, are 500 km apart and face each other. Find the distance between them 10 minutes before crossing.
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed of the trains when travelling towards each other = 80 + 120 = 200 km

Time taken when they meet = 500/200 = 2.5 hours = 150 min

Sum of distances travelled by the trains 10 minutes before meeting = 200 * (140/60) = 466.67 km

So, distance between trains 10 minutes before crossing = 500 - 466.67

= 33.33 km
questions.solution_hi:
Relative speed of the trains when travelling towards each other = 80 + 120 = 200 km

Time taken when they meet = 500/200 = 2.5 hours = 150 min

Sum of distances travelled by the trains 10 minutes before meeting = 200 * (140/60) = 466.67 km

So, distance between trains 10 minutes before crossing = 500 - 466.67

= 33.33 km

questions.q_en: A and B run a race of 6 km. First, A gives B a head start of 400 m and beats him by 120 seconds. While coming back, A gives B a lead of 4 minutes and gets beaten by 500 m. What is the difference between the times in minutes in which A and B can run the race for one side separately?
questions.solution_en:
When A covers 6000 m, then B covers 5600 meters

Let the speed of A and B be 'x' m/ minutes and 'y' m/minutes

5600/y - 6000/x = 120/60

5600/y - 6000/x = 2 .... (i)

When A covers 5500 m, then B covers 6000 meters

6000/y - 5500/x = 4 .... (ii)

Multiply (i) by 15/14

6000/y - 45000/7x = 15/7 ... (iii)

From (ii) and (iii)

x = 500 m/minutes

y = 400 m/minutes

Time taken by B to cover 6000 m = 6000/400 = 15 minutes

Time taken by A to cover 6000 m = 6000/500 = 12 minutes

Hence, the required difference = 15 - 12 = 3 minutes

questions.q_en: Which part contains the fractions in ascending order?

Three racers run on a circular track of 7 meter radius at the speeds of 2m/sec, 4m/sec and 11m/sec. If the bell rings at 12.00 PM when all the three racers are at the initial position, when would all the racers reach the finish line together for the first time?
questions.solution_en:
The speeds of racers are 2m/sec, 4m/sec and 11m/sec respectively.

The radius of the track is = 7m

Therefore the distance each runner needs to cover to finish the race = circumference of the circular track

Circumference of the track = 2 X 22/7 X radius = 2 X 22/7 X 7 = 44 meters

Time taken by each racer to finish race = (distance of track)/(speed of racer)

Time taken by individual racers are 22sec, 11sec and 4sec respectively.

Overall time taken until all the trackers finish the race together = LCM of time taken by each racer

LCM of time taken by each racer = LCM (22, 11, 4) = 44 seconds

So the final time when all the racers complete the race will be 12.00.44 PM.

questions.q_en:
Read the data carefully and answer the following question.

Following pie-chart represents the population of six cities i.e., P, Q, R, S, T and U.

Following table represents the female population of six cities.
CityFemale population
P28000
Q50000
R14000
S48000
T20000
U8000

If male population of city S is 40000 more than the male population of city P, then find the male population of city Q and T together.

Note: Total population of city = Total male population of city + Total female population of city
questions.solution_en:
Let total population of all six cities together = n

Then, total population of city P = 15% of n = 0.15n

Total population of city S = 30% of n = 0.3n

Male population of city P = 0.15n - 28000

Male population of city S = 0.3n - 48000

Now, 0.3n - 48000 = 40000 + 0.15n - 28000

0.15n = 60000

n = 400000

Total population of city Q = 25% of 400000 = 100000

Total population of city T = 15% of 400000 = 60000

Then, male population of city Q = 100000 - 50000 = 50000

Male population of city T = 60000 - 20000 = 40000

Therefore, male population of city Q and T together = 50000 + 40000 = 90000

questions.q_en: If one number is 13/15 times of another number and difference between the two numbers is 12, then what is sum of both numbers?
questions.solution_en:
Let one number is a and another number be b.

a/b= 13/15

Let a = 13k and b = 15k

So, b - a = 12

=> 15k - 13k = 12

=> k = 6

Hence, sum of both numbers = 13 * 6 + 15 * 6 = 168

questions.q_en: In a 12 km jungle trail race, explorer P allows explorer Q to start 4 km ahead as a friendly gesture. Surprisingly, they both reach the campsite finish line at the same moment. If Q's hiking speed is 16 km/h, what is P's actual speed?

questions.q_en: A ship can cover a distance of 48 km in downstream and after reaching to the destination it again returns to the mid-point in total of 3.5 hours. The ratio of speed of the stream and the downstream speed of the ship is 5: 16, then in how much time it will cover 42 km in upstream?
questions.solution_en:
Let speed of the stream = 5x km/h and downstream speed of the ship = 16x km/h

So, speed of ship in still water = 16x - 5x = 11x km/h and upstream speed of the ship = 11x - 5x = 6x km/h

According to the question,

48/16x + 24/6x = 3.5

=> x = 2 km/h

Required time = 42/(2 * 6) = 3.5 hours

One-quarter of a circular pizza of radius 21 cm was removed from the whole pizza. What is the perimeter (in cm) of the remaining pizza? (Use π =22/7)
questions.solution_en:
We know that perimeter of a circle=2*π *R

As pizza is circular

So perimeter of whole pizza= 2*22/7*21=132 cm

As one quarter was removed, so perimeter that was removed=132/4=33 cm

Three parts perimeter=132-33=99 cm

So total perimeter of remaining pizza=99+21+21 (as it will be 2*π *r +2r)

= 141 cm.

Option (b) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en:
Find the unit digit.

43 X 44 X 46 X 47 X 48
questions.solution_en:
• 43 → 3 → unit digit = 3

• 44 → 4 → 3 X 4 = 12 → unit digit = 2

• 46 → 6 → 2 X 6 = 12 → unit digit = 2

• 47 → 7 → 2 X 7 = 14 → unit digit = 4

• 48 → 8 → 4 X 8 = 32 → unit digit = 2

P, Q, and R run simultaneously, starting from a point, around a circular track of length 1800 m, at respective speeds of 23 m/s, 27 m/s, and 31 m/s in the same direction. After how much time will they meet for the first time?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed of P and R = 31 - 23 = 8 m/s

Relative speed of Q and R = 31 - 27 = 4 m/s

Net relative speed = 8 - 4 = 4 m/s

Time taken by them to meet for the first time = 1800/4 = 450 sec = 7 minutes 30 seconds

questions.solution_en:
By the ratio method,

Profit% = 40% or SP/CP = 7/5

Now,

(134.4/120) x (1000/X) = 7/5

X = 800

questions.q_en: AB is parallel to DC in a trapezium ABCD. It is given that AB > DC and the diagonals AC and BD intersect at O. If AO = 3x - 15, OB = x + 9, OC = x - 5 and OD = 5, and x has two values x1 and x2, then the value of (x12 + x22) is:
questions.solution_en:
In trapezium AB || DC, triangles AOB ~ COD:

AO/OC = BO/OD

(3x - 15) / (x - 5) = (x + 9) / 5

(3x - 15) * 5 = (x + 9) * (x - 5)

15x - 75 = x2 + 4x - 45

x2 - 11x + 30 = 0

(x - 5)(x - 6) = 0

x1 = 5, x2 = 6

x12 + x22 = 25 + 36 = 61
